messages.text: I'm in Batch 1 but I'm confused by descriptions being shown different places.
Different batches show different dates, so the page you're on now (Batch 7, ships November 30, 2026) won't match yours — Batch 1 is its own date. Which two descriptions are clashing for you?
Ad for Magic M. 40T says 30 BM1370 chips but shows a picturce containing 36 chips and Magic M. 40T description on Helium Deploy website says 28 BM1370 chips, so how many does it really have?
Read the magic miner 40t page
Searched the catalog · Magic M. 40T

The live listing is the spec of record: BM1370, 28 chips, 40 TH/s at ~650 W. The ad's "30" and the chip count you're counting in the photo don't match that, and I won't guess which render is accurate.

I've put it to JD on our hardware side to confirm the exact chip count on the shipping units. The team picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET and you'll get the answer by email.
Handed to the team · Spec conflict across ad, image and listing — can't confirm the real BM1370 chip
Anything else on the 40T I can check for you in the meantime?
No thats it, just excited to receive mine.  Thank you.
Used the chat-interview skill
Before you go, one thing: what made you go counting chips in the photos in the first place?
40 year air traffic controller here, learn to pay attention to detail so people wouldn't hear about me on the news

Forty years of that will do it, and you caught something real here.

What made the 40T the one you picked?
Was looking at the Avalon Q then the 40T appeared and I figured it was a good next step above my S1's.

Good call — the Avalon Q isn't one we'd steer you to anyway.

Last one: what had you considering the Q before the 40T showed up?
Just looking for more hash rate i can plug into the wall
Makes sense — 40 TH/s on a normal wall socket is exactly that. Thanks for telling me, and enjoy the 40T when it lands.
Have a great night
You too — the chip count answer comes to your email tomorrow.
Thank you
Anytime. Take care.
